about: Revvd challenges in the open worlds, played solo or by a whole room at once (games/moto/game.py reads this too). kind: race = first to the finish pad (from/to are safe-pad ids); air = longest single jump in seconds; flips = most flips landed; tricks = most trick points; speed = highest speed in km/h. at = a safe-pad id or 'park' (the send-it jump park). limit = seconds. vehicle: 'mtb' = an Unrevvd challenge, ridden on mountain bikes (the rest are on dirt bikes). cam: 'first' = ridden in the first-person camera.

challenges.name: The Big Drop
challenges.about: Race from the top of Sheerwall's 400 m cliff down to the valley floor. Take the cliff road, or send it straight off the edge and land it.

challenges.name: Summit Downhill
challenges.about: From the Frostpeak summit down to the frozen lake. Any line you like: first one down wins.

challenges.name: Mesa Dash
challenges.about: Off Eagle Mesa and across the desert to Switchback Basecamp. Fastest rider wins.

challenges.name: Cloudbreak Descent
challenges.about: Down the mountain from the lookout tower to Ranger Valley, through the forest or round it.

challenges.name: Big Air
challenges.about: 90 seconds at the send-it park. Your single longest jump counts (land it!).

challenges.name: Flip Frenzy
challenges.about: Two minutes to land as many flips as you can. Crashed flips don't count.

challenges.name: Top Speed
challenges.about: One minute to hit your highest speed. Find a long slope and send it. Stock engines only!

challenges.name: Sunset Run
challenges.about: From the top of Sunset Crest back to Caravan Camp, over the dunes. First one home wins.

challenges.name: Red Oak Rush
challenges.about: Down from Red Oak Summit through the autumn woods to Maple Lodge.

challenges.name: Trick Jam
challenges.about: Two minutes at the jump park. Supermans, no-handers, whips, 360s and flips all score: land them!

challenges.name: Dune Launch
challenges.about: 90 seconds to find the biggest air at the Oasis jump park.

challenges.name: Escape the Volcano
challenges.about: From the Crater Rim down to Ash Camp. Mind the lava pools on the way: first one out wins.

challenges.name: Lava Leap
challenges.about: 90 seconds at the Hot Springs jump park. Your single longest jump counts.

challenges.name: Peak to Beach
challenges.about: From the top of Parrot Peak down to the Surf Shack. Any line you like, but not through the lagoon.

challenges.name: Splash Flips
challenges.about: Two minutes at the beach jump park to land as many flips as you can.

challenges.name: Summit Send
challenges.about: From the Summit Hut down to the Trailhead. The flow trail, the rock garden or straight through the trees: first one down wins.

challenges.name: Timber Run
challenges.about: First person, down the Timber Chute: a steep gully packed with pine trees, rocks, stumps and fallen logs. Find a line through and hit the kickers to clear the rocks. Touch anything and you crash.

challenges.name: Frozen Run
challenges.about: First person, down the Frost Chute: a new gully, buried in snow and still snowing. Snowy pines, rocks, stumps and logs: touch anything and you crash.

challenges.name: Night Run
challenges.about: First person, down the Midnight Chute in the dark. You only see what your lamp lights up (and a few lanterns). Touch anything and you crash.

challenges.name: Autumn Run
challenges.about: First person, down the Autumn Chute: golden aspens dropping their leaves, and their slim white trunks are just as hard as a pine's. Touch anything and you crash.

challenges.name: Fog Run
challenges.about: First person, down the Fog Chute. The fog rolls in and out: a hundred metres one moment, five the next. Go fast while you can see.

challenges.name: Storm Run
challenges.about: First person, down the Storm Chute in the pouring rain. Lightning lights up the forest now and then, and the mud is slippery: steer gently.

challenges.name: Snowboard Run
challenges.about: Down the Frost Chute on a snowboard. No pedals: gravity does the work. Carve between the trees (A / D), and Q / E to flip off the kickers.

challenges.name: Falls to Lake
challenges.about: Carvvd's big one: from the frozen falls high on Frostpeak all the way down to the lake on a snowboard, 1.6 km. Any line you like, but it only goes downhill.

challenges.name: Summit Air
challenges.about: 90 seconds from the top of Frostpeak on a snowboard: find the biggest drop on the way down. Your single longest jump counts (land it!).

challenges.name: Avalanche
challenges.about: One minute from the summit to hit your top speed on a snowboard. Point it straight down and hold on.

challenges.name: Midnight Carve
challenges.about: The Midnight Chute on a snowboard, in the dark. Your lamp and a few lanterns are all the light there is. Touch anything and you crash.

challenges.name: Lantern Hunt
challenges.about: The Midnight Chute in the dark: ride past the glowing lanterns to collect them on your way down (get within a few metres). Most lanterns by the time you reach the bottom wins.

challenges.name: Forest Tag
challenges.about: Tag in Tag Wood (rooms only). One rider is it: ride into someone to pass it on. Whoever spends the least time being it wins.

challenges.name: The Grind
challenges.about: Pedal from the Trailhead all the way up to the Summit Hut. No engine, no nitro: just your legs.

challenges.name: Bike Park Air
challenges.about: 90 seconds at the bike park's jump line. Your single longest jump counts (land it!).

challenges.name: Backflip Bonanza
challenges.about: Two minutes on the jump line to land as many flips as you can on a mountain bike.

challenges.name: Terminal Velocity
challenges.about: One minute from the top of the mountain to hit your top speed. Point it downhill and hold on. Stock legs only!

challenges.name: Cloudbreak on Two Wheels
challenges.about: The Cloudbreak Descent on a mountain bike: from the lookout tower down to Ranger Valley.

challenges.name: Snow Shredder
challenges.about: Bomb down from the Frostpeak summit to the frozen lake on a mountain bike. Mind the ice!
